title.zh: 阿波罗 17 号月面铭牌

edition.en: Transcribed from NASA photograph S72-55169, a replica of the plaque
edition.zh: 据 NASA 照片 S72-55169（铭牌复制品）录文

note.en: The last plaque an Apollo crew left on the Moon, fixed to the ladder of the lunar module Challenger in the valley of Taurus–Littrow in December 1972. Between the two hemispheres of Earth sits a small round picture of the Moon itself. The word to notice is 'first': the people who wrote it expected the exploration to be continued by others, and said so in steel.
note.zh: 这是阿波罗乘组留在月球上的最后一块铭牌，1972 年 12 月固定在陶拉斯–利特罗山谷中“挑战者”号登月舱的梯子上。地球的两个半球之间，嵌着一小幅圆形的月球图。值得留意的是“第一次”这个词：写下它的人预期这场探索会由别人继续下去，并把这份预期刻进了钢里。

excerpt.orig: MAY THE SPIRIT OF PEACE IN WHICH WE CAME / BE REFLECTED IN THE LIVES OF ALL MANKIND
excerpt.en: May the spirit of peace in which we came be reflected in the lives of all mankind
excerpt.zh: 愿我们来时怀着的和平之心，映照在全人类的生活之中
